title: Terms and Conditions
subtitle: Terms governing the relationship between patient and practice.

sections.heading: Scope of services
sections.body: I offer the following dental services:
items: Complex cases (referral to specialists as needed)

sections.heading: Appointments
sections.body: Appointments are coordinated via WhatsApp, email, or web form. The appointment is confirmed once the patient responds. Initial consultation lasts approximately 45-60 minutes. Cancellations with less than 24 hours notice may be subject to a cancellation fee.

sections.heading: Quotes and payments
sections.body: Consultation and standard procedure prices are published. Detailed quotes are provided in writing before any irreversible procedure. Accepted payment methods: cash, bank transfer, Pagopar, and credit/debit card (Bancard POS). We do not have direct insurance agreements. We issue a legal invoice with RUC for reimbursement purposes.

sections.heading: Patient responsibilities
sections.body: The patient agrees to: provide accurate health information; disclose medications, allergies, and pre-existing conditions; follow post-treatment instructions; notify the practice of any complications following a procedure.

sections.heading: Modifications
sections.body: These terms may be updated periodically. The current version is published on this page.
